pr_title: apiextensions: replace go-openapi with kube-openapi fork for validation
pr_body:
/kind cleanup
/kind api-change

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

go-openapi is a 40k+ LOC library whose behaviour implicitly defines our CRD schema API. The goals of go-openapi are very different than our very limited and hugely sensitive use-case (defining API). The PR is the counterpart to https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/pull/211 forking go-openapi and stripping >80% of code, focusing on the schema validation consisting of roughly 4.8k non-test LOC.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Closes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/95922.
Closes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/90128. Thanks @gautierdelorme.

```release-note
NONE
```

issue_context.title: Eliminate dependency on asaskevich/govalidator (used with go-openapi)
issue_context.body:
Notes from @sttts in https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C0EG7JC6T/p1592312250277400?thread_ts=1592287631.273100&cid=C0EG7JC6T
```
new versions of govalidator updates some regexes, this leaks into our API implementation and hence is a breaking API change. One can argue how serious it is, but this is another case which reminds us to finally fork the validation logic to have something stable suitable for an API.
```

Quote from @sttts in https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C0EG7JC6T/p1592312565278100?thread_ts=1592287631.273100&cid=C0EG7JC6T
```
there is a way in go-openapi to set your own set of validators. Currently it just hard-coded those from github.com/asaskevich/govalidator. We could fork github.com/asaskevich/govalidator (the validator we use. It's not super complex code after all), and set them to define the formats we supprt.
```
comments: ```the goal is to fork, but strip it down, like stripping 80% we don't need. The remaining part is the validator and the types for the OpenAPI spec. We will not re-join.```

review_comments: Can we remove the need for stripping unsupported formats since we now have control over the formats from strfmt?
Am not convinced though. It is another safety net without value to remove it.

nit: comment name needs to be `ToKubeOpenAPI`

can we also remove `ToGoOpenAPI` completely? https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6d1e60a5897b36576dbd559a21b515908ecf7ef3/staging/src/k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver/pkg/apiserver/schema/goopenapi.go
Adding this in parallel to `ToGoOpenAPI` is unfortunate. How will we avoid drift / bugs between the two? Is there a plan to eliminate one?
yes, we will cut the other (less-critical) bit of go-openapi dependency in the publishing pipeline.
